event_v0.doc:
Published once per successful batch: `("disburse", from, token)` topics
carrying the batch total and recipient count, so a payroll batch can be
found and reconciled from chain data alone. One event per batch, not per
line \xe2\x80\x94 per-line detail is already in the SAC transfer events, and event
bytes are the resource that caps batch size.
event_v0.name: DisburseEvent

function_v0.doc:
Transfers `amounts[i]` of `token` from `from` to `recipients[i]`.

Recipients may be classic accounts or contract accounts (such as passkey
smart wallets), since the token contract credits either the trustline or
a contract balance entry as appropriate.

The batch is validated in full before `from` is asked to authorize and
before any transfer runs, so a bad batch fails during simulation without
moving anything. On success one [`DisburseEvent`] is published.
function_v0.name: disburse
